description: A six-panel composite figure mixing XRD, EBSD mapping and grain-size statistics for the duplex lightweight steel. (a) XRD pattern over "Diffraction angle (degree)" = 20-100° with "Intensity (a. u.)" on y; labelled peaks are 100_B2, 111_VC, 111_Austenite, 110_B2, 200_VC, 200_Austenite, 111_B2, 200_B2, 220_Austenite (tallest), 211_B2, 311_Austenite and 222_Austenite, so Austenite, B2 and VC reflections coexist. (b) EBSD phase map, 30 µm scale bar, legend green = Austenite and red = B2, annotated "f_B2=20%": equiaxed green austenite with red strip-like bands plus fine red particles at boundaries. (c) IPF map (30 µm scale bar, 001/101/111 colour triangle) of equiaxed austenite with dark unindexed/B2 bands; (d) IPF map of B2 only, labelled "B2", showing scattered fine particles and elongated strip grains. (e) Austenite grain-size histogram (Frequency % = 0-16 vs Grain size of austenite µm) with a red "Gauss fitting" curve and printed D̄_γ = 1.31 µm. (f) B2 histogram (Frequency % = 0-14 vs Grain size of B2 µm) resolved into two Gauss fittings, printed D̄_band = 1.02 µm and D̄_particle = 3.38 µm, i.e. a bimodal B2 size distribution. The figure establishes a duplex austenite + ~20% B2 microstructure in which B2 occurs in two morphologies/size families.

subfigures.description: XRD pattern (red trace) with x-axis 'Diffraction angle (degree)' 20-100 and y-axis 'Intensity (a. u.)'. Labelled reflections: 100_B2, 111_VC, 111_Austenite, 110_B2, 200_VC, 200_Austenite, 111_B2, 200_B2, 220_Austenite (highest intensity), 211_B2, 311_Austenite, 222_Austenite, showing Austenite, B2 and VC phases.

EBSD phase map with legend 'Austenite' (green) and 'B2' (red) and annotation 'f_B2=20%'; equiaxed green austenite matrix with red elongated/strip-like bands plus fine red particles decorating grain boundaries. 30 µm scale bar at lower right.
IPF orientation map with 001/101/111 colour triangle (top right) showing equiaxed, multi-coloured austenite grains cut by dark (black) banded regions; 30 µm scale bar.
IPF map labelled 'B2' with its own 001/101/111 colour triangle, showing only B2: numerous small equiaxed particles and a few elongated strip-like larger grains, 30 µm scale bar.

Grain-size frequency distribution of austenite: histogram (Frequency %, 0-16) versus 'Grain size of austenite (µm)' up to about 4.5 µm, with a red 'Gauss fitting' curve and printed mean D̄_γ = 1.31 µm.

Grain-size frequency distribution of B2: histogram (Frequency %, 0-14) versus 'Grain size of B2 (µm)' up to 6 µm with two red 'Gauss fitting' curves, indicating a bimodal distribution; printed values D̄_band = 1.02 µm and D̄_particle = 3.38 µm.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is an XRD pattern whose labelled reflections belong to three phases: Austenite (111, 200, 220, 311, 222), B2 (100, 110, 111, 200, 211) and VC (111, 200); the tallest peak is 220_Austenite.
Panel (b) prints the annotation 'f_B2=20%' alongside a legend of green = Austenite and red = B2.
The citing text states the B2 volume fraction (V_B2) was quantified as 20% from the XRD direct comparison method using integrated intensities of multiple peaks.
The citing text states the IPF maps (Figure 2c,d) show equiaxed austenite while B2 appears in two forms: long strip-like large grains and fine particles decorating austenite grain boundaries.
Panels (b), (c) and (d) each carry a 30 µm scale bar.
Panels (c) and (d) include IPF colour-triangle legends labelled 001 (top), 101 (left) and 111 (right).
Panel (e) prints the mean austenite grain size D̄_γ = 1.31 µm and overlays a red curve labelled 'Gauss fitting'.
Panel (f) prints two mean values for the bimodal B2 distribution, D̄_band = 1.02 µm and D̄_particle = 3.38 µm, with two red curves labelled 'Gauss fitting'.

The printed labels in (f) assign the smaller mean size (1.02 µm, first sharp peak) to the 'band' population and the larger mean (3.38 µm, second broad hump) to the 'particle' population, whereas the citing text describes the band-like grains as the large ones and the decorating particles as fine; the two readings appear inconsistent.
The citing text states the grain-size distributions give an average austenite grain size of 1.31 µm and a bimodal B2 distribution with mean sizes of 1.02 µm and 3.38 µm.
The citing text states phase fractions obtained from the equilibrium phase diagram, XRD and EBSD analyses are consistent with each other.
Panel (c) contains black, band-shaped regions whose identity (unindexed zones versus masked B2) cannot be decided from the pixels alone.

unreadable_items: panel (c): the black band regions are not labelled; whether they are unindexed areas or masked B2 is not determinable from the pixels
